Marta G: Heads-up — starting a small pilot with NorthBridge SI next week to validate a co-sell routing pattern. Goal: reduce lead drop between demo handoffs and shorten time-to-first-call.
Priya S: 👍 can you spell out the routing rules we want to test? who owns demo vs follow-up?
Marta G: Quick outline: SI claims any inbound that meets both: (1) SI has existing relationship in SFDC (Contact or Account tagged NB-Partner), and (2) estimated ARR >= $50k. Redwood retains outbound-sourced demo ownership unless SI claims within 48h.
Jayden K: Sounds reasonable. Proposal for automation: when a lead has NB-Partner tag, set owner to partner-queue and create a task for "SI claim window" with 48h expiry.
Samir R: @Jayden can you add a check for duplicate accounts? We saw a case where both SI and Redwood had leads for same ACV and it led to friction.
Jayden K: Will do. Plan: run a dedupe on email+company during ingest, if match -> create a co-advocate record linking Redwood rep + SI rep.
Priya S: For co-advocate records, what's the expected notification pattern? SI should get an email + slack mention, and Redwood rep must get a follow-up task assigned.
Marta G: Notification plan: atlas-bot will post to #partnerships with a short summary + mention both advocates. Email to SI EOM and task created in SFDC for Redwood rep. If SI doesn't claim in 48h, owner auto-reverts to Redwood rep.
Carlos L: For demos — rule: whoever claims the lead first runs the initial demo. If Redwood demos but SI has strong influence, SI gets follow-up enablement session. We should capture 'demo owner' in SFDC field.
Priya S: Agreed. Also adding a flag for "co-sell follow-up required" with standard playbook link.
Marta G: Playbook draft: 1) Intake + dedupe; 2) SI claim check; 3) Notification + co-advocate creation; 4) Demo owner runs call; 5) Joint follow-up within 5 business days if ACV>100k.
Samir R: Can we add an exception: if opportunity is in an existing Redwood pipeline stage (Demo/Proposal) older than 30 days, do not reassign automatically — notify partnership ops for manual review.
Jayden K: Yup — we'll add a gating rule in the workflow. I'll push rule changes on Tuesday and post the flow diagram.
Marta G: Kickoff call Thursday 10am PST with NB PM, SI AE, and ops. Agenda: confirm tags, test dataset for dedupe, SLA timings, rollback criteria. @atlas-bot can you schedule and attach the draft playbook?
atlas-bot: Scheduled meeting Thu 10:00 PST. Draft playbook uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-pilot/northbridge-playbook (permissions: partnerships-view)
Priya S: Action items: Jayden to add gating rules + flow diagram; Samir to prepare a 200-lead test CSV; Carlos to add SFDC fields; Marta to confirm NB participants.
Marta G: Thanks team — goal is 2-week pilot, measure time-to-first-call and claim accuracy. We'll review metrics in the next partnership sync. :rocket:
_meta: Generated Slack thread for SI co-sell pilot routing — single continuous message string with participants and metadata
